# Tabbio Partner Program

> Tabbio helps UGC creators, career coaches, CV writers, recruiters, talent specialists, and agencies turn useful career work into trackable referrals.

## Key facts

- Tabbio is a UAE-based business. Applications may be open to eligible partners worldwide, subject to local law, program approval, and payout availability.
- Partner commission: a proposed 30% of eligible net, settled, attributed subscription payments.
- Main workflow: apply, complete required checks, share a partner link, track commission.
- Agency workflow: screen or shortlist a candidate, create a Tabbio CV, send a tracked or claim link, and earn if the eligible candidate subscribes.
- Client fees and services remain between the partner and client. Tabbio subscription commission is separate.
- Partner tools: candidate CV handoff, tracked links, content drafts, disclosure copy, resources, and earnings history.
- UAE advertiser rules apply to advertising activity from within the UAE. Visitors have a separate official permit route. Partners outside the UAE follow their local rules.
- Important: eligibility, attribution, refunds, checks, and payout rules follow the current program terms.
- Prototype boundary: team-level agency tracking, real attribution, payouts, and compliance checks are not connected in this frontend build.
